verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) and markdown docs at /doc.md that point agents to the llms.txt documentation index. The quickstart links a 'Build with AI' guide for preparing agents, and an official agent-skills repo exists. The llms.txt content itself covers clients, products and SLA. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration that agents work well with these docs, and detail on the contents of the 'Build with AI' guide.
